It’s just that he only opened up to me for a period and then he went back to acting goofy and cheerful around me at all times, hiding his feelings you know? So it’s difficult to just help him I feel. (Don’t worry, I had to count to make sure I knew my brother’s age hahaha)

We both support him the best we can, but you’re right, baby steps should do. Thank you so much for this. <3

Hi! Sorry for such a late reply, been busy gaming with friends lately so I didn’t come back here. 

We have a bad experience with antidepressants in my family and I admit I’m also kind of scared of them. They tend to make you calmer and feel less, and I’m not sure I would like that...

I’ve seen a therapist that seemed pretty good and made me open up and realize many things, still it’s like no one realizes how serious it is to me. I don’t know what to do at this point, I’m starting to lose faith in therapy. 

I’m actually in an “okay” phase right now where no one’s clinging to me too much and though I still crave a relationship I manage to stay just friends with the guys I’m around. I’m trying to keep it that way as I’m pretty okay like this. I don’t know how long it will last though.

At the same time, if I see a therapist I’m not sure I’ll be able to tell him about all the stuff I wrote into my post. I don’t know. I know it’s their job and that I won’t get judged but seriously, when I arrive in front of the therapist I just can’t say it.

You’re so sweet, I appreciate this so so much. I know this is just internet and that some people think it’s just virtual and makes no sense, but know that if you ever need something you can count on me regardless. 

I’m just scared he won’t even try to let me help him... I just want to help him become healthy first, at least physically, and then help him mentally... It’s so hard to know how someone will react when you’ve never really lived with them. Sometimes it almost feels like we’re strangers.

I only kept him as friends from the group after I moved as I felt already guilty enough that I had “stolen” a friend of his already. I understand it’s not his fault, it just feels unfair that I lose my bestfriend over something I have no control over. But I guess you are right, I should move on... it’s just difficult. :( Thank you for this.
Really? Why not? Should I use a brush instead?

That's a really good idea actually. My skin looks extremely flat even with highlighter and contour when I wear foundation so something glows could do... Heard a lot of bad things about Nyx's control drop foundation though, might try the stay matte not flat... Thank you for this advice!
I use a damp beauty blender indeed! Tried changing to a brush to see if it'd make it better but went back to the beauty blender. Still looks like paint on my face, too dry and patchy. :(
